description: Defines the QuicSimpleServerSession class, a subclass of QuicServerSessionBase, specific to a toy server implementation for the QUIC protocol. It includes methods for creating streams, handling stream frames, and negotiating WebTransport support.

classes.name: QuicSimpleServerSession
classes.description: A subclass of QuicServerSessionBase implementing server-specific behavior for a toy QUIC server, including stream creation and WebTransport negotiation.

methods.name: QuicSimpleServerSession
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session with configuration, supported versions, connection, visitor, helper, crypto config, certs cache, and backend.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming stream frames, with custom logic for client data on server push streams.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Creates an incoming SPDY stream based on stream ID or pending stream.

methods.name: CreateQuicCryptoServerStream
methods.description: Creates a QUIC crypto server stream.

methods.name: server_backend
methods.description: Returns the backend associated with this session.

methods.name: ShouldNegotiateWebTransport
methods.description: Determines if WebTransport should be negotiated based on backend support.

methods.name: LocalHttpDatagramSupport
methods.description: Returns local HTTP datagram support, considering WebTransport negotiation.
